name: community/crypto
description: A2's cryptography as it stands: ciphers (AES, DES/3DES, Blowfish, CAST, IDEA, Twofish, ARC4), hashes (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-3/Keccak) and HMAC over them, big numbers and primes, RSA/DSA/Diffie-Hellman, the Fortuna generator and a CSPRNG, ASN.1 and X.509.
residual: Vendored from minia2 source/ on 2026-08-27, when std stopped carrying it: the standard library holds what packages talk to each other through, and crypto is a leaf ob get can deliver (docs/STDLIB.md there). The sources also stay in minia2 source/, because dropping them would break the full A2 build and widen the diff against vanilla ETH -- so this is a second copy on purpose, and `upstream` names where the first one is.

Not modernised, only moved. There is no Ed25519, no X25519, no ChaCha20-Poly1305, no HKDF here, and ARC4, Blowfish, CAST, IDEA, DES and DES3 are kept for compatibility rather than recommended. DES and CryptoDES are two implementations of the same cipher; nothing here imports DES, only VNC does.

The two Base64s were collapsed in minia2 on 2026-09-03 and CryptoBase64 left this package with them: the 27.08 note that nothing imported either was wrong -- CryptoRSA and CryptoDSA both did, under the alias Base64. They now import the Base64 of std/encoding, which is that same implementation under its own name.
